title: Law to add higher tax breaks for lower-income senior homeowners
summary: This bill would let seniors with the lowest incomes get a bigger property tax exemption under the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption. Starting July 1, 2026, homeowners earning less than $47,000 could get a 65 percent exemption, with 60 percent for those earning $47,000-$48,000 and 55 percent for those earning $48,000-$49,000, up from the current 50 percent cap. The change builds on a recent state law allowing cities to expand this tax relief.
